concept: Engraved brass on an oxblood front door. The end of a nameplate for a made-up company, seen from its left: QUAY LTD and two screws. Then the same view pushed in until LTD fills the plate. Then a second, longer plate carrying the four things gov.uk says a limited company's website has to show, one to a line. Oxblood gloss paint, polished brass with a strip of sky along the top, black enamel and cream.
